dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: When will Big Brother be able to return home...

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: He's super awesome! He joined the army, and he's... Uh, in a really far away place, protecting all of us.

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: This mission must be pretty important. He's been out for a really long time now...

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: But I'm not a crybaby or a little kid anymore. I'll wait for him to come back.

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: The last time my brother wrote back, he wrote about all sorts of things that happened to him out there. He sounded like he was in really high spirits. It must be because the mission's going well, and he can return soon!

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: In that case, I'll go grab some flowers. When he comes back, I'll give them to him!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will you be alright by yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I always go out and play, so I know the area around the village like the back of my hand.

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: Even if I fall down, I've got Big Sis Reirei to help me.

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: Big Sis Reirei's a doctor. She's a bit fierce, but she always helps me bandage the broken skin up, and she gives me some nice snacks, too!

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: Of course, I know that I shouldn't run around all the time and trouble everyone. My brother said that good kids learn from their mistakes, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm, thanks! You really remind me of my brother. He's always reminding me to do stuff too, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: Oh, here's something that I found while I was out playing. You can have it!

dialogues.speaker: Mirai
dialogues.text: It's okay, just take it. I've got lots of time to go find more.
